quick.name: Buzzer beater
quick.note: It gets out with a split second left. It was right there.

quick.name: It’s faster
quick.note: It moves a third faster. Still escapable?

quick.name: Two of you
quick.note: Two balls, one stalker. The first one out wins; it may catch the other.

overlay.title: It only needs one of you.

quick.name: Lights on
quick.note: The same chase with the lights on: you can see it coming.

quick.name: Toxic
quick.note: Sickly green rings in the dark.
